## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what this change does for users.

## Validation

List relevant checks and their results. For evaluator changes, include honest partial repairs,
equivalent reconstructions and adversarial candidates; explain score or contract changes.

## Scope

- [ ] Inputs and fixtures are synthetic and redistributable; no private tasks or traces.
- [ ] Documentation and migration notes reflect any public behavior change.
- [ ] Known limitations and unverified editor behavior are stated.
